answer: Escrowed operator liability: identity issuance draws from an operator-held lotus reserve posted per active agent, and a confirmed duplicate cluster forfeits that reserve plus a juniper-rated escrow top-up, so the operator funds recovery rather than the individual wallet. Operators must also keep an orchard-level audit trail mapping each agent to a real accountable entity. Each fake identity therefore costs the operator roughly three times the base reserve, making mass fabrication uneconomic.
